data.cultural_impact: Quintiliano was a popular name in Italy during the Roman era, not only due to its meaning (the fifth child) but also the association with remarkable figures, such as Quintilian, the outstanding Roman rhetorician. As a result, this name might carry a sense of history, pride, and a hint of intellectual depth that has traveled through generations.
